name: Kasshoku no Sei Senshi Aisha
original_name: 褐色の性戦士アイシャ
source:
Aisha is a warrior of the desert kingdom of Kaldir.
Her noble spirit and dedication to daily training as a warrior earned her the support of many citizens from the kingdom.
Her maid, Fara, also strives daily to maintain her purity, and the two of them lead very fulfilling lives.

One day, the two are caught up in an incident that occurs within the castle, and are suspected of being the murderers of the royal family.
Aisha and Fara plead their innocence, claiming they are not murderers, but their pleas are not heard and they imprisoned them.
As they spend their time in the filthy, maggot-infested prison, the two begin to lose their sense of reason, and are persuaded by the nobleman Khalifa to enter into a sexual contract.

Having made this contract, hellish days await them as "warriors" and "sexual contractors"...

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=921847]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
艾莎是沙漠王国卡尔迪尔的一名战士。她高尚的精神和日复一日的刻苦修炼赢得了王国许多民众的支持。她的女仆法拉也每天努力保持纯洁，两人过着非常充实的生活。

一天，两人被卷入了城堡内发生的一起事件，被怀疑是杀害王室的凶手。艾莎和法拉申辩自己无罪，声称她们不是凶手，但她们的申辩无人倾听，她们被投入了监狱。在肮脏、蛆虫横行的牢房中度过时光后，两人开始丧失理智，被贵族哈里发说服签订了性契约。

签订这份契约后，作为“战士”和“性契约者”的地狱般的日子在等待着她们……
